styles.label: text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-slate-400

rules: Use 'tracking-tighter' on all headings larger than 24px to kill the default Inter look.
Use 'font-black' (weight 900) for hero text to make it graphic and poster-like.
Never use pure black (#000000) for text. Use slate-900 (#0f172a).

usage.primary: Main CTAs (Add to Cart, Checkout), Price tags, Active states.
usage.background: Main page background. Keep it clean white.
usage.surface: Cards should be white with a subtle border, NOT gray backgrounds.
usage.text: High contrast. Slate-900 for headings, Slate-600 for body.

buttons.primary: bg-green-500 hover:bg-green-600 text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-transform active:scale-95 shadow-lg shadow-green-500/20
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 text-slate-900 font-medium rounded-full px-6 py-3

cards.product: group relative bg-white rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100 hover:border-green-200 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-md
cards.category: flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 hover:border-green-500 hover:bg-green-50 transition-colors cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap

inputs.default: h-12 rounded-lg border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 focus:bg-white focus:border-green-500 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-green-500/20 transition-all

layouts.mobile_nav: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-slate-100 flex justify-around items-center z-50

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on green backgrounds is white. Ensure all text on light backgrounds is slate-900 or slate-600.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all mobile interactive elements.

media.images: object-cover w-full h-full transition-transform duration-700 group-hover:scale-105

hero.description: Dark moody gourmet burger for Hero section

instructions_to_main_agent: MOBILE FIRST: Design for the phone screen first. The desktop version is just a stretched mobile version with a grid.
SPEED IS KING: No heavy animations. Use CSS transitions. Load images with 'loading=lazy'.
NAVIGATION: On mobile, use a sticky bottom bar (Home, Menu, Cart, Profile). On desktop, use a standard top nav.
CART: The cart should be a Drawer (Slide-over) on the right side, accessible from anywhere.
ADMIN: Keep the admin panel simple. Use a sidebar layout. Focus on data density (tables).
TYPOGRAPHY: Since we are forced to use Inter, make it interesting by using 'tracking-tighter' on headings and 'text-slate-500' for secondary text.
SHADCN: Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (Dialog, Drawer, Sheet, Form) but style them with the classes defined in 'components' section.
ICONS: Use Lucide React icons. Keep them thin (stroke-width={1.5}) for a modern look.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid white or very subtle slate-50.
Do not center text in product cards. Left align title and price for faster scanning.
Use 'gap-1' for price and title spacing. Keep it tight.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and inputs.
